usage.source_scope: Only the ordered word-level geometry and joint character/centerline representation are in scope.
usage.project_application: Replace the merged-line center used by L10 bearing with a word-level geometry carrier on fixed ArTVideo frames while keeping semantic identity and the temporal state machine frozen.
usage.modifications: Treat DeepSolo only as a geometry source. Existing OCR remains the lexical authority, and geometry cannot create or rebind target identity.
usage.expected_effect: Improve target-word bearing when adjacent words were merged into one OCR line without increasing wrong lexical admission or changing identity persistence.

evaluation.claim_boundary: Even a positive fixed-frame result would establish only a better text-geometry carrier on that replay. It would not establish temporal reacquisition, physical identity, entrance affordance, metric arrival, live-device control, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: The route-specific literature reserve selected DeepSolo as a geometry-only candidate and fixed the smallest useful comparison.

history.change: Imported the L10 literature candidate into the cross-route reserve without authorizing an experiment or changing the current route.
